shots.prompt: Camera flies between floating islands at sunrise, waterfalls pouring into clouds
lines: NARRATOR
The year is 2300. Earth is a memory. Humanity lives in the sky.

shots.prompt: Slow push through the capsule hall, mist rolling, one capsule light turns from red to green
lines: NARRATOR
Twenty-three capsules. Twenty-two of them dark. One was about to wake.
Yirmi üç kapsül. Yirmi ikisi karanlık. Biri uyanmak üzereydi.

shots.prompt: Fast aerial flight diving through clouds between islands
The capsule lid slides open with hissing mist, she gasps and sits up quickly, breathing hard
lines: NARRATOR
For three hundred years she had slept. Now, her first breath.
Üç yüz yıl uyumuştu. Şimdi, ilk nefesi.

shots.prompt: She looks around frightened
lines: ASHLEY
Where am I? Why can't I remember anything?

shots.prompt: Frost cracks on the capsules, steam bursts from pipes
The turquoise orb flies down and circles playfully around, sparkling
lines: COMPASS
Hello, Twenty-Three. I am Compass. I have waited a long time for you.

shots.prompt: She climbs out of the capsule, stumbles, catches herself and walks toward the light orb
lines: NARRATOR
Her legs remembered how to walk before her mind remembered anything at all.
Bacakları yürümeyi, zihninden önce hatırladı.

shots.prompt: Ashley touches a glowing wall panel, holographic symbols race across it
lines: NARRATOR
The walls spoke a language she somehow understood.
Duvarlar, nedense anlayabildiği bir dilde konuşuyordu.

shots.prompt: She speaks to the floating orb
lines: ASHLEY
Twenty-Three? Is that my name?

shots.prompt: The orb pulses brighter, projecting a hologram of the girl's face
lines: COMPASS
Your name is Ashley. And you are the last one awake.

shots.prompt: The orb zips around the hall leaving a turquoise light trail
Ashley runs between the other 22 capsules, wiping frost off the glass, all empty and dark
lines: NARRATOR
Every capsule was empty. Every name was gone.
Her kapsül boştu. Her isim kaybolmuştu.

shots.prompt: She turns around worried
lines: ASHLEY
Where are the others? There were twenty-three of us!

shots.prompt: Ashley shields her eyes from the bright sun, hair whipping in strong wind
Alarm lights flash red, Ashley spins around as a door opens to blinding daylight
lines: NARRATOR
Then the alarms began. Someone knew she was awake.
Sonra alarmlar çaldı. Biri uyandığını biliyordu.

shots.prompt: Ashley steps outside and freezes at the edge, wind whipping her hair, awe on her face
lines: NARRATOR
Outside, the world she forgot was waiting.

shots.prompt: A huge sky whale-shaped ship passes slowly behind the islands
Ships glide between islands, birds fly past, bridges of light connect towers
lines: NARRATOR
Elyra. The sky city. Built by the last people of Earth.
Elyra. Gökyüzü şehri. Dünya'nın son insanlarının eseri.

shots.prompt: She looks out in wonder
lines: ASHLEY
Islands in the sky. This can't be real.

shots.prompt: Lightning strikes a crystal tower, sparks rain down
The hologram flickers violently, the young man's face appears through static, shouting
lines: KAI
Twenty-Three! If you hear this... the Fortress... help me!

shots.prompt: Ashley reaches toward the flickering hologram, eyes wide
lines: NARRATOR
A face from a dream. Or from a life she had lost.
Bir rüyadan tanıdık bir yüz. Ya da kaybettiği bir hayattan.

shots.prompt: Ashley breathes hard after landing, then smiles nervously
She whispers, shaken
lines: ASHLEY
I know that face. I don't know how, but I know him.

shots.prompt: The orb spins fast and shows a glowing map with a red dot far away
lines: COMPASS
His signal comes from the Broken Isles. It is dangerous.

shots.prompt: She clenches her fist, determined
lines: ASHLEY
Then that's where I'm going.

shots.prompt: Ashley runs and leaps onto a moving platform of light that carries her across the sky
lines: NARRATOR
No map. No memory. Only a signal, and a promise.
Harita yok. Hafıza yok. Sadece bir sinyal ve bir söz.

shots.prompt: The light platform zooms between floating islands, clouds rushing past
Approaching the shattered islands, blue crystals glowing, thunder rolling
lines: NARRATOR
She didn't know who she was. But she knew someone needed her.

shots.prompt: Ashley lands hard, rolls and stands up, looking around the broken island
lines: NARRATOR
The Broken Isles. Nobody comes here by choice.
Kırık Adalar. Buraya kimse isteyerek gelmez.

shots.prompt: She calls into the wind
lines: ASHLEY
Hello? Is anyone out here?

shots.prompt: The cat in a tiny helmet leaps out from behind a rock and stares at her, tail up
A brown-haired young woman steps out of the mist pointing her staff
lines: AVA
Don't move. Who sent you?
